topic.title: Inviting Team Members
topic.shortdesc: How to invite new members to your organization and assign them a user role.

body.p: Only users with an Organization Administrator role can invite new members to the organization. Invitations are managed from the Organization Members page.

ol.li: Click your user name in the top-right corner of the interface.
Select Manage organization from the drop-down menu.
Click Members in the left navigation panel.
Click the Invite member button in the top-right corner.
Enter the email address of the person you want to invite.
Select the user role (Author or Subject-Matter Expert) from the drop-down.

body.note: A license seat is automatically allocated when the invitation is sent, even before the invitee signs up.
Pending invitations appear in the members list and can be cancelled at any time.
